CustomField.description: The engagement link this booking draft was typed on. Blank on every Draft_Type__c = 'Assessment' row -- the readiness questionnaire is minted from a bare /assessment route with no ?cfgId= and has no engagement link at all. Required relaxed to false so this object can hold both row types; GtmFormDraftController's own isLinkWritable() gate is what actually enforces this on the Booking path now.
CustomField.label: Engagement Link
